{{Top}}
'''Karlini tea''' was a variety of [[Tea/Legends|tea]]. Shortly after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] served cups of it to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] in Padmé's apartment. Obi-Wan refused to drink it, but Padmé did.
